title: Test Effectiveness — M9-C42.17 Test Contribution & Credit-Card Survivor Analysis

remain_ordinary_tests.evidence: Both files live under backend/tests/ in ordinary pytest module layout, require no special runner, carry no custom marks, and are collected by plain `pytest`.

normal_pytest_collection.evidence: `pytest tests/unit/engines/credit_card/test_mutation_gap_repairs.py tests/unit/engines/loan/test_loan_engine.py --collect-only -q` => '268 tests collected in 0.92s'. No collection errors.

participate_in_coverage.evidence: Both directories are inside `tests/`, which the canonical coverage command executes. Under coverage the engines they target report credit_card 93.65% and loan 98.73%. Neither file is named in the .coveragerc omit list (which omits only */tests/* from being MEASURED as source — a normal, correct setting that does not stop tests from EXECUTING and generating coverage).

not_excluded.evidence: No skip markers (0), no xfail markers (0), no `pragma: no cover` (0), no entries in pytest norecursedirs or ignore lists, no exclusion in .coveragerc.

not_implementation_dependent.evidence: Zero private-attribute access (`._x` pattern: 0 matches in both files). Zero mock/patch/MagicMock usage (0 matches in both files). Tests assert on public function return values and raised exceptions only.

not_tautological.result: PASS with one documented minor observation
not_tautological.evidence: Zero literal self-equality asserts (0). Zero bare `assert True` (0). credit_card: 132 asserts across 124 tests. loan: 263 asserts across 159 tests.

minor_observation.nature: Non-asserting placeholder tests whose bodies are a comment plus `pass`. Both carry an explicit inline rationale: '`outstanding_paise > 0` -> `>= 0` is equivalent (guarded by <0 check)' — i.e. they document an EQUIVALENT (unkillable) mutant rather than assert behavior.
minor_observation.classification: NOT tautological (they assert nothing at all, rather than asserting a trivial truth) and NOT harmful (they cannot produce a false pass signal for production behavior). They are, however, non-contributing tests.
minor_observation.recommended_action: Convert to a module-level comment or an explicit documented xfail in a future housekeeping pass. NOT changed in this phase (out of scope; would constitute touching M9-C42.17 test work without mutation evidence).
minor_observation.impact_on_conclusions: NONE — neither test affects any mutation score or coverage figure materially.

assert_production_behavior.evidence: Tests exercise public engine APIs and assert returned financial values, schedule structures, and raised exceptions. Corroborated behaviorally: the loan engine's completed mutation run kills 1,066 of 1,269 evaluated mutants (84.0%) and credit_card kills 440 of 582 (75.6%) — a test suite that did not assert real production behavior could not kill mutants at these rates.

comparison_against_m9_c42_17.explanation: The M9-C42.17 inventory (144) was generated from a slightly earlier survivor snapshot than the authoritative 142-survivor population reproduced in M9-C42.18 and re-verified in M9-C42.19. The 2-mutant difference is a snapshot-timing artifact, not a classification disagreement. The A/B proportion is unaffected for analytical purposes.
comparison_against_m9_c42_17.classification_stability: STABLE — the same modules dominate survivors in both snapshots.

genuine_vs_unavoidable.note: Counts on the 142-survivor population are proportional estimates derived from the M9-C42.17 per-survivor classification; the classification itself is per-mutant and evidence-backed in that artifact.

ceiling_analysis.headroom: 26 required vs ~43 genuine behavioral gaps available => 80% is reachable using ONLY real behavioral-gap repairs, with 17 gaps of margin. No equivalent mutant needs to be chased and no test needs to be manufactured.

are_additional_tests_justified.answer: YES — but on behavioral-gap grounds, NOT on percentage grounds.
are_additional_tests_justified.justification: The M9-C42.17 inventory identifies ~43 survivors as class A 'REAL TEST GAP', each with a recorded source file, line, mutation operator, original vs mutated expression, and an explicit affected-behavior statement. Those are genuine, documented behavioral gaps in production code and are worth closing on their own merits.
are_additional_tests_justified.explicit_caveat: The justification is the documented existence of real behavioral gaps. It is NOT 'the number is below 80'. If the inventory had shown 142 equivalent mutants and 0 real gaps, the correct action would be to raise the equivalent-mutant ceiling issue, not to add tests.
are_additional_tests_justified.action_taken_this_phase: NONE. No tests were added. Per the phase mandate ('Do not manufacture tests to manipulate the mutation percentage' and 'establish the metrics, do not optimize them'), the gaps are DOCUMENTED for a future targeted phase.
are_additional_tests_justified.recommended_future_scope: Close class-A survivors in the highest-survivor modules first: billing.py (43 survivors), interest.py (26), foreclosure.py (16), metrics.py (16), utilization.py (15), emi.py (14), outstanding.py (12).
